Hilchos Pesach 5

The Matter of the Exodus in Every Generation and in Every Person, and the Matter of Eating Matzah

Based on Likutay Moharan I:36 — "Bikrov Alai M'ra'im Le'echol Es B'sari"

Based on the discourse "When evildoers draw near to me to devour my flesh," in Siman 36 — see there the entire discourse.

For there are seventy souls of the House of Ya'akov, corresponding to the seventy faces of the Torah. And every soul of Yisrael has a root in the seventy souls mentioned above. Corresponding to them are seventy nations, and each nation has a bad middah and evil desire that is rooted in it. And there is the all-encompassing desire that includes all seventy nations — which is the desire for immorality, in which they are all rooted and immersed. And every soul of Yisrael, before it has some revelation in the Torah, is tested and refined in the exiles of the seventy nations — that is, in their evil desires. And the essential test is with the all-encompassing desire mentioned above. For when the soul of a Jewish person is tested with this desire, this is the aspect of the exile of the seventy nations. And then it cries out seventy cries, like a woman giving birth, etc. And then, when one breaks this desire and withstands the test, one merits afterward to give birth to a revelation of the Torah. And for this reason Moshe Rabainu, who was the totality of the Torah, was completely separated from all of this, etc. And Bil'am, his counterpart in the k'lipah, was immersed, etc. Also, Yosef had to withstand the test, etc. — in order to merit the revelation of the Torah, the aspect of chochmah and binah.

segments.he: וביום ראשון של סוכות מתחילין ליטול הלולב עם הד' מינים שהם בחינת תיקון הברית (כמובא בספרים) שזה בחינת ח"י נענועין שבלולב בחינת צדיק ח"י עלמין בחינת צדיק כתמר יפרח. ועל כן מתחילין ליטול אותן ביום ראשון של סכות כדי לקיים את הסוכה שלא תפול ח"ו בבחינת סוכת דוד הנופל. שזה נעשה ח"ו על ידי שמתיזין הדמים של השס"ה גידין שהם השס"ה לא תעשה לתוך המוח שמזה בא ח"ו חולי נופל בחינת סוכת דוד וכו' וכל זה על ידי העדר תיקון הברית עיין כל זה במאמר הנ"ל המתחיל האי מאן דבעי למנסב וכו' (בסימן כ"ט). על כן נוטלין הד' מנים שבלולב שהם בחינת תיקון הברית שהוא זורק תיקונים ולבנונית לכל השס"ה גידין ועל ידי זה אנו סומכין וסועדין ומרימין את הסוכה הנ"ל שלא תפול ח"ו כנ"ל. ועל כן הם ד' מינים כנגד ד' בגדי לבן שנמשכין על ידיהם על ידי שמרימין את המוחין ומקיימין את הסוכה הנ"ל שמשם נמשך לבנונית בבחינת דם נעכר ונעשה חלב (כמובא שם כנ"ל) שזה בחינת הסוכה שהיא בחינת אם לבינה תקרא בבחינת תסוכני בבטן אמי ששם בחינת בבחינת אם לבינה בחינת סוכה שם הדס נעכר ונעשה חלב שמזה נעשין בגדים לבנים. וכנגד זה נוטלין ד' מינים שבלולב כנגד ד' בגדי לבן שנעשין על ידם כנ"ל ועל כן מתחילין ליטול הלולב ביום ראשון של סוכות כי בנין הסוכה והקמתה נעשה על ידי הכח התלבנות העוונות שנעשה ביום הכפורים על ידי תיקון הברית על ידי זה יש לנו כח לבנות הסוכה כנ"ל. ועל כן תיכף במוצאי יום הכפורים מתחילין לעסוק בסוכה מיד וכל הד' ימים שבין יום הכפורים לסוכות עוסקים בבנינה. כי בכל אלו הד' מים אין מחשברין בהם העוונות ועל כן הם ד' ימים כנגד ד' בגדי לבן שנמשכין ביום הכפורים שעל ידיהם נמשכך הלבנוניות לכל אלו הד' ימים ועל כן אין מוחשבים בהם העווונת. ומחמת זה עוסקים בכל אלו הד' ימים בנין הסוכה כי אז יש לנו כח לבנות הסוכה ולהקימה על ידי הלבננות העוונות והדמים כנ"ל. ועל כן ביום ראשון של סוכות שאז הוא ראשון לחשבון עוונות על כן אנו יריאים שלא יתגברו העוונות בחינת הדמים להפיל בחינת הסוכה ח"ו כנ"ל על כן נוטלין הד' מינים שעל ידם סומכמין סוכת דוד שלא תפול ח"ו כנ"ל. ובשביל זה אומרים הלל עם הלולב כי הלל הוא בחינת תיקון הכללי של הדיבור בבחינת ברכו ה' מלכיו וכו' דהיינו על ידי שבח צדיקו של עולם והילולו על ידי זה נתתקן הדיבור (כמו שכתוב שם במארמ הנ"ל). ועל כן נוטלין אז הללולב שהוא גם כן בחינת תיקון הכללי של הגידין כי כל בחינת תיקונים הכללים המבוארים שם במאמר הנל תלוים זה בזה (כדמשמע שם במאמר הנ"ל).והעיקר תלוי בתיקון הברית שהוא כלליות הגידין שהוא עיקר כלל כל התיקונים. וזה ברכו ה' מלאכינו גבורי כח עושי דברו לשמוע וכו' שפירשו רבינו נ"י על תיקון הכללי של הדיבור על ידי ברכו ה' עיין שם. וזה שכתוב בפסוק מלאכיו גבורי כח שהם בחינת שומרי הברית אינון דמתגברין על יצריהון דדמיין למלאכים ממש ואותן דייקא יכולים לתקן הדיבור על ידי שבח צדיקו של עולם כי זה תלוי בזה כנ"ל. וזה בחינת נטילת הלולב שהוא בחינת תיקון ברית כלליות הגידין בעת אמירת ההלל שהוא שבח השם יתברך שהוא תיקון הדיבור כגי שניהם בחינתיקון הכלצלי ותלוי זה בזה כנ"ל ועל כן הנענועים שהם עיקר המצוה הם בהודו תחילה וסוף כי הודו לה' שהוא עיקר שבח צדיקו של עולם על כן אז עיקר מצות לולב שהם הנענועים כי הנענועים הם עיקר תיקון הברית. ועל כן הם שה לכל הו' קצוות שזה בחינתיקון הברית שהוא בחינת וא"ו. ובכל קצה ג' נענועים שבין כולם ח"י נענועים בחינת צדיק ח"י עלמין וכמובא. כי הלולב הוא בחינת כלי המלחמה לנצח ולהתגבר על השבעים אומות (כמו שכתוב בזוהר הקדוש), היינו שעל ידו מנצחין ומתגברין על הרע כולל של השבעים אומות שהוא תאוות ניאוף וזוכין לתיקון הברית שהוא תיקון הכללי כנ"ל שהוא בחינת שד"י שדי ויורה כחץ תיקונים לכל מקומות הצרים והדקים (כמובא במאמר הנ"ל). וזה בחינת הנענועים ושמנענעין וזוריקם כלי המלחמה לכל צד וצד ובצידי צדדים לכווין כל י המלחמה להיות קולע אל השערה כדי לנצחם ולהכניעם בכל מקום שהם ועל ידי זה בעצמו נזרקין תיקונים לכל הצדדים לכל מקומות הצרים והדקים כנ"ל שזה גם כן בחינת הנענועים שמנענעין וזורקין תיקונים לכל צידי צדדיים בבחינת שד"י כנ"ל. כי זה תלי בזה על ידי התגברות ונצחון המלחמה שזהו עיקרה תיקון שהוא בחינת תשובת המשקל ממש על ידי זה נזרקים תיקונים לכל מקומות הדקים כנ"ל. וזה בחינת הלולב שהוא עולה ומשופע והולך עד שבראשי הוא דק מאד הורות שהוא מנענע וזורק תיקונים לכל מקומות הצרים והדקים כנ"ל גם בהלל נזכר הכנעת הר הכולל שם השבעים אומות. בחינת סבוני וכו' בשם ה' כי אמילם מ"ל בגיטריא שבעים אומות שזה בחינת מילה (כמובא בשערי אורה) ומילה הוא בחינת הכנעת הרע הכולל היינו התאווה הכלליות הנ"ל כמובא במאמר התפילה לחבקוק (סימן י"ט) על כן נוטלין אז הלולב כנ"ל כי הוא כלי המלחמה כנגדם כנ"ל:
segments.en:
And the tikkun for impure thoughts that come upon a person is to say Sh'ma and Baruch Shem — in order to include one's soul in the twelve tribes of Y-a-h through K'rias Sh'ma, which is the aspect of the acceptance of the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven — the aspect of the Sea of Sh'lomoh that stands upon twelve oxen, etc. — and to separate one's soul from the souls of the Airev Rav, who come from the harlot, the evil maidservant, which is the spleen — the mother of the Airev Rav, etc. — see there. But one who is habituated in the thoughts of the all-encompassing desire must also shed tears at the time of accepting the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven — for tears come from the residue of the black bile, and when one sheds tears the residue is expelled — that is, the desire for immorality that comes from the turbidity of the blood of the spleen, which is the black bile, etc. — and one includes one's soul in the Kingdom of Heaven.

And this is a great principle: from the Most High issues forth only simple light. But according to the nature of the vessel that receives the light, so is the light depicted within it. If the vessel is in a state of completeness, then the light is depicted in the aspect of blessing — and vice versa, chas v'shalom. For the simple light that comes from Above is in the aspect of kamatz — closed and sealed. But according to the nature of the receiving vessels, it is in the aspect of tzairai — that the light is depicted according to the nature of the vessel. And therefore it is written regarding Bil'am: "Behold, to bless I have taken" (hinai varaich lakachti) — "lakachti" with a kamatz, and "varaich" with a tzairai. For even the taking — which is in the aspect of kamatz, closed and sealed — is in the aspect of varaich (blessing). This is a proof, for he wanted the light to be depicted according to the nature of his vessel, which was the aspect of a curse — but he was unable to reverse it, etc. And this is the aspect of: "He blessed, and I cannot reverse it." And the reason is that the verse testified regarding them that Yisrael are called the tribes of Y-a-h, etc. And the essential completeness of the vessel — which is the aspect of one's capacity to grasp the mochin — is according to the tikkun of the bris. And then one can receive and grasp the Torah of the tzaddik — for the light is depicted in one's case for good and for blessing, through the completeness of one's vessel, which is one's capacity to grasp the mochin according to the tikkun of the bris (see there well).

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 1 ~

And this is the aspect of the exile of Mitzrayim. For it is known and well-established that the essential exile of Mitzrayim was on account of the blemish of the bris. The seventy souls of the House of Ya'akov had to be tested and refined in the exile of Mitzrayim, which is the aspect of the exile of the seventy nations — for the exile of Mitzrayim encompasses all the exiles of all seventy nations (as brought in the Midrash: that all exiles are called by the name "Mitzrayim," as brought in the words of our Rebbe). For the Mitzrim are the "nakedness of the earth" (ervas ha'aretz), steeped in immorality — that is, they are the aspect of the all-encompassing exile of the seventy nations, the aspect of the all-encompassing desire, which is the desire for immorality in which the Mitzrim were immersed more than all.

It follows that when the seventy souls of the House of Ya'akov came into the exile of Mitzrayim, this is the aspect of the exile explained in the discourse: the exile of every soul of Yisrael that must come into the exile of the seventy nations — that is, into the all-encompassing desire, which is the aspect of the exile of Mitzrayim, for they were steeped in immorality. And for this reason the exile of Mitzrayim encompasses all exiles — because they were immersed more than all in the all-encompassing desire of the seventy nations, which is the essential exile. And therefore the exile of Mitzrayim and the Exodus from Mitzrayim apply to every person and in every time — for every individual must be tested with the all-encompassing desire, which is the aspect of the exile of Mitzrayim. And to the degree that one merits to break the all-encompassing desire and leave the exile of the all-encompassing desire of the seventy nations — this is the aspect of the Exodus from Mitzrayim. And when the soul of a Jewish person comes into this exile, it cries out seventy cries, like a woman before giving birth. And this is the aspect of: "And the children of Yisrael cried out to Hashem" — and: "Hashem heard our voice," etc. — said regarding the exile of Mitzrayim, which is the aspect of the above exile — the aspect of the cries that the soul cries out when it comes into this exile. And the essential purpose of the exile of Mitzrayim was in order to come to the revelation of the Torah — for afterward they merited the receiving of the Torah at Har Sinai.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 2 ~

And the essential redemption was through Moshe, who was completely separated from the above desire. Also, Yisrael were fenced off from immorality in Mitzrayim, and through this they merited the redemption. But even so, it is brought that they were still not worthy of being redeemed were it not for His kindness, blessed be He — for the Mitzrim had such a hold on them that it was impossible for them to leave were it not for His great kindness and awesome wonders that He performed then. And the essential illumination that came from Above on the night of Pesach, through which they were redeemed, was accomplished not through our agency at all (as explained in the Pri Aitz Chayyim).

That is, it is explained in the discourse that the light that comes from Above is in the aspect of kamatz — closed and sealed. Each person, according to his vessel, merits to receive the light — or the opposite, chas v'shalom. And since it was still before the appointed end, and they were not yet worthy of being redeemed — for their vessels were not yet completed in perfection so that they could receive the light in the aspect of m'oros (luminaries) in its full form to be redeemed thereby — as it is written: "And I passed over you and saw you wallowing in your blood." "In your blood" — this is the aspect of the exile of the desire, which comes from the blood. For even though they were fenced off from immorality, nevertheless the refining was not yet fully completed, and their vessels were not yet perfected so that they would be worthy of redemption. And as is explained in many places and in the verses, that they were not yet worthy — as it is written: "And you were naked and bare." For the Mitzrim had seized hold of their vessels deeply, for they were sunken in the forty-nine gates of impurity, as is brought.

And because of this, if the light had been depicted according to the vessel — as is always the custom — they would not have been able to be redeemed, for it would have been depicted, chas v'shalom, in reverse, since the vessel was not in a state of completeness due to the impurity of Mitzrayim that had seized hold of them. And this was the great miracle and wonder that Hashem performed with us then — that Hashem Himself, in His own glory, descended to redeem us, as it is written: "And I will pass through the land of Mitzrayim," etc. That is, He did not deal with us according to the way of nature — that is, as He always conducts: a simple light descends from Above and is depicted below according to the nature of the receiving vessel. Rather, He performed wondrous kindness and wonders with us then, and drew down the light from Above in the aspect of blessing and goodness — in the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken" — that even the taking is in the aspect of blessing. And this occurred at the time of the Exodus from Mitzrayim: the light was depicted Above in the aspect of blessing. And therefore, even though the impurity of Mitzrayim had seized hold of their vessels, the light was not depicted in reverse, chas v'shalom — since it descended from Above in the aspect of blessing and goodness. Through this they were redeemed — for this great illumination that came from Above in the aspect of blessing and goodness subdued the impurity of Mitzrayim, and their vessels were purified through this, and they were redeemed.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 3 ~

And this is the aspect of is'ar'usa dil'aila (arousal from Above) before is'ar'usa dil'sata (arousal from below) that occurred at the Exodus from Mitzrayim (as explained in the Writings). For normally one must first rectify one's own vessel — this is the aspect of is'ar'usa dil'sata: by sanctifying and purifying oneself, one rectifies one's vessel — and afterward one can receive the light that descends from Above, which is the is'ar'usa dil'aila, for then one can depict the light for good. But now, at the time of the Exodus, it was impossible to conduct things this way, since the Mitzrim had such a hold on them. If He had waited until their vessels were completely purified to receive the light, they could never have been redeemed at all, for the Mitzrim had too strong a grip. Therefore Hashem performed wondrous kindness with us and overrode the constellations and conducted Himself with us in a way beyond nature — He brought down the supernal light in the aspect of blessing from Above, even though their vessels were not yet fully purified. And on the contrary, through this great light that descended from Above in the aspect of blessing, the impurity of Mitzrayim was subdued and nullified, their vessels were purified, and they merited redemption.

segments.he: וזה בחינת ניסוך המים בחגכי על כל הקרבנות היו מנסכין יין. כי הקרבנות הם תיקון הברית כי הם מכניעים רוח בההמיות שהוא פגם הברית כנ"ל. וזה שכתוב ולא תשבית מלך ברית אלקיך מעל קרבניך ועל כן היו מנסכין אז יין כי על ידי תיקון הברית נמתק היין. ואזי אדרבא על ידי היין ניתוסף התיקון ביותר כי נתרומם המוח על ידו בבחינת זכה נעשה ראש (כמובא במאמר הנ"ל). וזהו שאומרים שירה על היין היינו שירות ותשבחות להשם יתברך שהוא גם כן תיקון הכללי על ידי הרמת הדעת שנעשה על ידי שבח צדיקו של עולם. וזה בחינת השירה של נסכים של הקרבנות כנ"ל. ומחמת שבסוכות אז הוא בחינת תיקון הברית ביותר כנ"ל ואז נתלבנין ונזדככין הדמים מאד על כן מנסכין אז מים ויין ביחד (כמו שכתוב בהמשנה להורות שנמתק היין מאד בהמתקה יתירה עד שנמתק בבחינת מים כי המים הם בחינת חסדים והם המזגת והמתקת היין. וזה שנרמז נסמוך המים בין נסכי היין כמו שדרשו רז"ל (תענית) נאמר בשני ונסכיהם וכו'. כי ניסוך המים הוא מתיק את היין כנ"ל ועל כן שמחים מאד בשמחת בית השואבה. כי כשנמתק היין אז הוא בבחינת יין המשמח ומשם גם כן שמחת כל החג על ידי שזוכין לסוכה שהוא בחינת אם לבינה ששם יין המשמח. ואז בשמחת בית השואבה זוכין להשגת החכמה מאד כמו שכתוב ושאבתם מים בששון ותרגומו ותקבלון אולפן חדת כי אז נתרומם המוח מאד בבחינת זכה נעשה ראש (כמו שכתוב שם). ועל כן שמחים בשאיבת המים. כי הם בחינת המתקתו כנ"ל ונעה יין המשמח שהוא בחינת השגת החכמה כמובא:
segments.en:
✦ ✦ ✦

~ 4 ~

And this is what Bil'am said to Balak: "Behold, to bless I have taken, and He has blessed — I cannot reverse it." For even the taking was in the aspect of blessing, etc. And this is what he said afterward: "He has not beheld iniquity in Ya'akov, and has not seen perversity in Yisrael." And Rashi explains: even when they sin before Him with a transgression, He does not scrutinize them, etc. That is, when Yisrael sin, chas v'shalom, and then their vessel is damaged through the sin, and the light would naturally be depicted, chas v'shalom, in reverse — but Hashem does not scrutinize Yisrael and deals with them beyond the letter of the law. When they stumble in a transgression, chas v'shalom, He draws down the light from Above in the aspect of blessing — in the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken" — so that the light should not be depicted in reverse, chas v'shalom, through the damaging of their vessel. And this is: "Hashem his G-d is with him," etc. — for always Hashem Elokim is with them, and He Himself, as it were, depicts the light in the aspect of blessing. And this is the aspect of Hashem Elokim: Hashem is the aspect of simple light; Elokim is the aspect of tzairai, the aspect of the depiction of the light. That is, Hashem Elokim is with him — that He Himself, as it were, depicts the light for good, so that it should not be depicted, chas v'shalom, in reverse through the damaging of the vessel because one stumbled in some transgression, chas v'shalom.

And this is what was said afterward: "G-d brings them out of Mitzrayim." And Rashi explains that he said to Balak: You said "a people came out of Mitzrayim" — as if they left on their own. But "G-d brings them out of Mitzrayim" — Hashem took them out, and they did not leave on their own. That is, Balak said they left on their own — meaning, their redemption was according to the rectification of their own vessels. And therefore it would be possible to scrutinize them and find some blemish to seize hold of them and damage their vessels so that the light would be depicted in reverse. But in truth it is not so. Rather, "G-d brings them out of Mitzrayim" — Hashem Himself took them out through is'ar'usa dil'aila without is'ar'usa dil'sata. For He did not wait for the light to be depicted according to the nature of their vessels, which is the is'ar'usa dil'sata. Rather, G-d brings them out of Mitzrayim — He Himself depicted the light for good and brought the light down from Above in the aspect of blessing — the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken." And therefore it is impossible to curse them in any way — for it is impossible to depict the light in reverse — the aspect of: "He blessed, and I cannot reverse it."

And this is the aspect of the patience (arichas apayim) with which Hashem is patient — perhaps one will return. And this is the aspect of His stretching out His hand to accept in t'shuvah — and "one who comes to be purified is assisted." That is, when a person sins, chas v'shalom, and if the light descended according to his vessel, the light would be depicted in reverse, in the aspect of "he did not merit," etc. And if so, how could he ever return? But Hashem is full of mercy, and t'shuvah preceded the world, and one who comes to be purified is assisted — that is, whenever any person comes to be purified and to return in t'shuvah, Hashem draws down the light upon him in the aspect of blessing from Above. And through this one is purified from one's impurity and merits to return. And this is the assistance from Above. For when one merits to return from one's sins, this is the aspect of the Exodus from Mitzrayim, as is known and as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of eating matzah — because the dough of our fathers did not have time to become leavened until the King of Kings, the Holy One blessed be He, was revealed upon them and redeemed them, as it is said: "And they baked the dough," etc. For matzah is the aspect of very great mochin that come from Above. For matzah is dough that one does not allow to become leavened; rather, one bakes it immediately while it is still matzah, before it comes to leavening. That is, the aspect of the light that comes from Above, which is kamatz — closed and sealed — simple light that is normally depicted according to the nature of the vessel. But now it is depicted immediately Above in the aspect of blessing, before it descends to be depicted below according to the vessel.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 5 ~

And this is matzah — the aspect of a very great light that is baked immediately, for the light is depicted immediately from Above before it comes to leavening. For chamaitz is the aspect of depiction, where there are two possibilities: "he merited — it becomes for him an elixir of life; he did not merit" — etc. For chamaitz is the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, which has two forces within it. For chamaitz is the aspect of depiction that begins to leaven and take shape — as our Sages said: the signs of chamaitz are like the antennae of grasshoppers. But matzah is the aspect of baking and depicting the simple light in the aspect of blessing — before it reaches the stage of leavening to be depicted below.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 6 ~

And therefore throughout the year one may eat chamaitz — for one can also below depict the light for good and for blessing through the mitzvos of the Torah. And this is the aspect of the ten mitzvos that apply to bread — all in order to depict the shefa (flow of sustenance) for blessing.

For eating is the aspect of shefa, the aspect of mochin, as is brought. And this is the aspect of mat'nos k'hunah (priestly gifts) — t'rumah and ma'asros. For one must give t'rumah to the Kohain in order to extract the grain from the curse with which the ground was cursed through the sin of Adam HaRishon — as it is written: "Cursed is the ground," etc. And therefore one must give t'rumah to the Kohain — for the Kohain can draw down the simple light that comes from Above, which is in the aspect of kamatz — closed and sealed — the aspect of "v'kamatz haKohain" (and the Kohain shall scoop) — and depict it for blessing. For the Kohanim are in the aspect of guarding the bris, through which their vessel is in a state of completeness — as it is written: "And Your covenant they shall guard." And as it is written: "A covenant of eternal priesthood."

And this is the aspect of Bircas Kohanim being placed next to Sim Shalom. For the Kohanim, who are in the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain, draw down the light that comes from Above — which is kamatz and sealed — and depict it for blessing through Bircas Kohanim. And the essential thing is through the completeness of their vessel, since they are in the aspect of guarding the bris — for among the Kohanim there are more mitzvos regarding the holiness of the bris than among ordinary Yisrael, as it is written: "They shall be holy... a harlot, etc., they shall not take," etc. And therefore Bircas Kohanim is next to Sim Shalom, and the essential conclusion of their blessing is with shalom — as it is written: "And He shall place upon you peace." For shalom is the vessel that holds blessing — as our Sages said: the Holy One found no vessel to hold blessing for Yisrael but shalom. And therefore through this the Kohanim draw down the light that comes from Above — which is kamatz and sealed, the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain — and depict it for blessing through shalom, which is the aspect of the vessel in its completeness — for shalom is the aspect of guarding the bris, the aspect of: "Behold, I give him My covenant of peace."

segments.he: ועל כן מרבין בשירות ותשבחות בשמחת בית השואבה. שזה בחינת תיקון הדיבור כנ"ל. ועל כן היו מתפארין אז שזכו להיות נקיים מעוונות (כמו שכתוב שם) זקנים מה היו אומרים אשרי זקנותינו שכפרה וכו' כי העיקר שמחת בית השואבה שנעשה בסוכות הוא רק על ידי שזכו להזדככות הדמים שעל ידי זה נמתק היין ונמזג במים כנ"ל. וזה שהיו אומרים אנו לי"ה ולי"ה עיניו שזה בחינת המוחין בחינת קנה חכמה קנה בינה שהם י"ה:
segments.en:
✦ ✦ ✦

~ 7 ~

And therefore one prays regarding a dream at the time of Bircas Kohanim that it should be transformed from bad to good. For all dreams follow the mouth — for the dream shows a person that something is descending upon him, for good or, chas v'shalom, for the reverse. And therefore the essential dream is according to the thought in the mind — as it is written: "And the visions of your head upon your bed ascended." That is, according to the rectification of one's thought and mochin, which is one's vessel — so does the light descend upon one, for good, etc. And accordingly one is shown in the dream. And since the matter has not yet been drawn down below, but is only shown in a dream, therefore all dreams follow the mouth. For the essential completion of the vessel is through the mouth, where the mochin are revealed — the aspect of: "From His mouth come knowledge and understanding." And there is the essential completion of the vessel. And therefore through the mouth, which is the aspect of the vessel, one can depict the light as one wishes — for good or for the reverse. And therefore all dreams follow the mouth.

And therefore one prays regarding the dream at the time of Bircas Kohanim — for then the light is depicted for good. And therefore then one can transform the dream from bad to good — through the Kohanim who bless at that time, drawing the light from Above and depicting it for good and for blessing through the rectification of the vessel, through the aspect of shalom — the vessel that holds blessing. And this is what we mention in the prayer recited regarding a dream at the time of Bircas Kohanim — the transformation of the curse of Bil'am the wicked from curse to blessing. For this is the aspect of the tikkun of the dream: depicting the light for blessing, in the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken."

And this is what we ask in Bircas HaMapil: "And let not my thoughts and bad dreams trouble me... and let my bed be complete (sh'laimah)," etc. A "complete bed" — this is the aspect of the tikkun of the bris, the aspect of the bed of Ya'akov, from which came forth the twelve tribes of Y-a-h, which are the aspect of a "complete bed," as Rashi explains. And the twelve tribes are the aspect of the tikkun of the bris (as explained in the discourse). And through this the vessel is in a state of completeness, and then the dreams are settled. And this is: "Let not my thoughts and bad dreams trouble me... and let my bed be complete."

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 8 ~
segments.he_nikud:
וְעַל-כֵּן מַרְבִּין בְּשִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת בְּשִׂמְחַת בֵּית הַשּׁוֹאֵבָה שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הַדִּבּוּר כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַל-כֵּן הָיוּ מִתְפָּאֲרִין אָז שֶׁזָּכוּ לִהְיוֹת נְקִיִּים מֵעֲווֹנוֹת, (כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר שָׁם) זְקֵנִים מֶה הָיוּ אוֹמְרִים: אַשְׁרֵי זִקְנוּתֵנוּ שֶׁכִּפְּרָה וְכוּ'. כִּי עִקַּר שִׂמְחַת בֵּית הַשּׁוֹאֵבָה שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה בְּסֻכּוֹת הוּא רַק עַל-יְדֵי שֶׁזָּכוּ לְהִזְדַּכְּכוּת הַדָּמִים שֶׁעַל-יְדֵי זֶה נִמְתָּק הַיַּיִן וְנִמְזָג בְּמַיִם כַּנַּ"ל. וְזֶה שֶׁהָיוּ אוֹמְרִים אָנוּ לְיָ"הּ וּלְיָ"הּ עֵינֵינוּ, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת הַמֹּחִין, בְּחִינַת קְנֵה חָכְמָה קְנֵה בִינָה שֶׁהֵם יָ"הּ: 

~ אות ד

וְ

segments.en:
And this is the aspect of mat'nos k'hunah — t'rumos and ma'asros — in order to extract the grain from the curse, through the Kohain, who is the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain: he can draw down the simple light from Above, which is kamatz and sealed, and depict it for blessing. And this is the aspect of t'rumah to the Kohain and ma'asair to the Levi. For the Kohain is the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain — the simple light, kamatz and sealed. And the Levi is the aspect of tzairai, as is known — for Kohain, Levi, Yisrael are the aspect of Chochmah, Binah, Da'as. It follows that Levi is the aspect of Binah, which is the aspect of tzairai, as is brought. And therefore one gives t'rumah to the Kohain to elevate the grain to its root, which is simple light — the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain. And then it automatically leaves the curse, since it has been elevated to its root, which is simple light. And afterward one gives ma'asair to the Levi, who is the aspect of tzairai — so that the light and the shefa will be depicted for good and for blessing.

And this is the aspect of challah to the Kohain, which is given afterward from the dough. For afterward, when the dough is made, the dough begins to be depicted and to leaven. Therefore one must give a second gift to the Kohain — namely challah, which is also t'rumah — in order to elevate the dough once again to its root, to the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain, so that the light will be depicted for blessing. For at the time that dough is made, the Sitra Achara can reawaken, chas v'shalom — for they are the aspect of chamaitz and s'or, whose hold is specifically at the time the dough is made, for that is when the essential depiction of the shefa that comes from Above occurs. For as long as the grain has not become dough, its process is not yet complete; the essential completion is when it becomes bread — from when the dough is kneaded. And therefore then is the essential awakening of the Sitra Achara, which awakens specifically at the time the light is being depicted, in order to depict it, chas v'shalom, in reverse. And therefore then chamaitz and s'or awaken — which are the aspect of depiction, the aspect of "the signs of chamaitz are like the antennae of grasshoppers" — which is the aspect of the depiction of the light, as is known to the understanding. And therefore we once again give priestly gifts — challah to the Kohain — in order to elevate everything to its root, to the aspect of v'kamatz haKohain, so that through this the light will be drawn from Above and depicted in the aspect of blessing. For the Kohanim can draw the simple light from Above and depict it for blessing — which is the aspect of Bircas Kohanim.

And this is what is written regarding challah: "to rest a blessing upon your house." "To rest a blessing" specifically. And this is the aspect of brachah before and after — that we recite a brachah on everything — all in order to depict the light and the shefa, the vitality present in the thing from which one benefits, to depict it for blessing. And therefore one must recite a brachah before and after: before eating, in order that the light drawn from Above — the vitality of that item — should be depicted for blessing; and afterward, after eating, when the spirituality of the food spreads into the mochin and additional wisdom and da'as accrue through the eating. And each person receives vitality and mochin from eating according to his vessel — for in the case of the tzaddik, additional wisdom and da'as accrue through eating, and in the case of the wicked, the opposite — additional foolishness accrues through eating. Even though they both eat from the same dish — for it is all according to the vessel, for the vitality of the eating is drawn and depicted in each person according to his vessel, according to his capacity to grasp the mochin, for good or for the reverse, chas v'shalom. And therefore after eating, when the food begins to be clarified and the good and choice portion is drawn to the brain and depicted there in one's mind according to the rectification of one's vessel — therefore one must recite a brachah after the meal so that the light should be depicted for blessing at the time the vitality from the eating is drawn into the brain, which is the aspect of the vessel.

And this is the aspect of Bircas HaMazon. And this is the aspect of HaTov V'HaMailiv that we say in Bircas HaMazon — saying three expressions of goodness — in order that the light should be depicted for good and for blessing.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 9 ~

And behold, all of this applies throughout the year, when we are always engaged in depicting the light for blessing through the Torah and mitzvos. But now, at the time of the Exodus from Mitzrayim, before the receiving of the Torah — when they could not rectify their vessels in completeness on their own, due to the impurity of Mitzrayim — therefore we cannot eat chamaitz, which is the aspect of depiction: that we depict the light according to our own nature, according to the rectification of our own vessels. For the Mitzrim had seized hold of the vessels, and the light would have been depicted, chas v'shalom, in reverse. And therefore chamaitz is forbidden under bal yairah'eh and bal yimatzai — for then chamaitz is the aspect of a curse. And therefore we are compelled to eat matzah, which is the aspect of haste — for we do not wait until the light is depicted below. Rather, the light is drawn from Above in the aspect of blessing — the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken" — and this is the aspect of matzah that is baked immediately before it comes to leavening, which is the aspect of the depiction done below. For now we receive the light from Above in the aspect of blessing — and this is the aspect of matzah that is baked immediately.

segments.he: וזה בחנית הקפות שהיו מקיפין את הערבה בכל יום פעם אחת. ובהושנא רבא ז' פעמים עם הד' מינים כי הערבה הוא בחינת מלכות פה בחינת אמונה כמובא. ועל כן היו מקיפים אותה עם הלולב וד' מינים כדי להשלים בחינת הדיבור בחינת המלכות בחינת האמונה על ידי בחינת המקיפין שממשיכין אליה לבנונית ותיקון על ידם להלבישה בד' בגדי לבן הנמשכין משם על ידי ד' מינים שבלולב כנ"ל ועל כן בהושענא רבא היו מקיפין ז' פעמם כנגד ז' גלדי דעינא. שהם בחינת שערות בחינת מוחין במקיפין לבת עין (כנזכר שם בסוף המאמר). שהם מתקנים את הדם נדות כנזכר שם. כי כל עסקינו בכל ז' ימי הסוכות בסוכה ולולב ושאר תיקונים הכללים הנ"ל. הכל הוא כדי לזכות בהושענא רבא לחתום חותם החיצון שהיא בחינת אמונה שהיא נתתקנת על ידי תיקון הכללי של הדיבור כנ"ל כי אמונה תולה בפה של אדם כמו שכתב רבינו ז"ל (בסימן מ"ד בלקוטי תנינא) והכל תלוי בתיקון הברית כמובא בדברי רבינו בכמה מקומות שאמונה תלוי בתיקון הברית. ועל כן מצות הד' מינים הם תלוים בידים כי הם ניטלין בידים מחמת שהם באין לתקן חותם הידים שהוא חותם האמונה כנ"ל. והכלל שתיקון הברית ואמונה שהוא בחינת דיבור פה תלויים זה בזה והם בחינת חותם הפנימי וחותם החיצון שהם חותם הרגלין וחותם הידין בחינת חותם ברית הלשון וחותם ברית המעור שהם בבחינת כרת לו בין עשר אצבעות ידיו והוא ברית הלשון וכרת לו וכו'. והם בבחינת מה שאמר רבינו נ"י ששמירת הברית ושלימות לשון הקודש הם תלוים זה בזה כי הם בחינת ב' החותמות הנ"ל. שהם חותם בתוך חותם. וכל אחד תלוי בחבירו. ועל כן נעורים בליל הושענא רבא כדי לזכות לשלימות לשון הקדש שהוא בחינת מלכות פה וכו' שעיקר שלימותה על ידי לשון תרגום שהוא בחינת תרדמה ועל כן נעורים כדי להכניע בחינת השינה בחינת תרדימה (כמובא לעיל). וזה שאומרים אז משנה תורה שהוא בחינת משנה תורה בבחינת אלה הדברים אשר דיבר משה בעבר הירדן בבר הירדן דיקיא כי עבר הירדן הוא בחינת לשון תרגום המשלים את הלשון הקודש. כי לשון תרגום שהוא לשון ארמי הוא בעבר הירדן. ועל כן נטלו שם גם כן שבטי ישראל חלק ונחלה. כי ארץ ישראל הוא בחינת לשון הקדש כי לשון הקדש נבחר מכל לשונות העמים וכן ארץ ישראל נבחר מארצות שבעים עממין וישראל שנבחרו משבעים אומות זכו לשניהם. כי ארץ ישראל הוא גם כן בחינת קדושת הברית בחינת צדיקים ירשו ארץ והוא בחינת אמונה שהוא בחינת מלכות פה בחינת שלימות לשון הקדש כמו שכתוב שכן ארץ ורעה אמונ (כמו שכתב רבינו) וישראל זכו לחלקם ונחלתם את ארץ ישראל כי הוא שייך לעם ישראל כולם צדיקים לעולם ירשו ארץ. ומאחר שעיקר שלימות לשון הקדש על ידי לשון תרגום הוא בחינת עבר הירדן בחינת לשון ארמי כנ"ל על כן הוכרחו ישראל ליטול שם חלקם גם כן כדי להשלים בחינ לשון הקדש על ידי לשון תרגום שהוא בחינת ער הירדן כ"ל. וזה שבתחיל קצף משה מאד על בני ראובן ובני גד על שבחרו בערב הירדן כי סבר שהם רוצים לישאר שם. על כן קצף עליהם מאד. כי בחינת לשון תרגום אין לו שום שלימות וקדושה בעצמו כי אם כשמשלים את לשון הקדש. ועיקר המלחמה על ידו ועל כן כשהשיבו לו שהם יעברו חלוצים לפני אחיהם כי עיקר המלחמה על ידם. ועל כן הם צריכים דייקא לעבור חלוצם לפני המלחמה כי עיקר המלחמה והנצחון הוא בבחינת לשון תרגום (כמובא לעיל בהלכות חול המועד). ואחר כך כשינצחו המלחמה ישובו אז לשבת שם כי אז כשמכניעין לגמרי הרע של השבעי אומות. ואזי התרגום משלים את הלשון הקדש. אז התרגום גם כן קדש ועל כן יכולין אחר כך לשבת בעבר הירדן שהו בחינת תרגום כנ"ל. ועל כן אחר כך נתרצה להם משה רבינו עליו השלום וזה שאמרו רז"ל לעולם ישלים אדם פרשיותיו עם הציבור שנים מקרא ואחד תרגום ואפילו עטרות ודיבון שהם ערי עבר הירדן והוא תמוה למה תסו זה הפסוק הלא גם על זה הפסוק יש תרגום עכשיו ואפילו אם נאמר בדוחק שבימיהם לא היה תרגום על זה הפסוק אף על פי כן קשה היו להם לתפוס פסוק ראובן ושמעון שאין עליו שום תרגום אפילו עכשיו והוא מוקדם בתורה. אך הרבותא שפאילו עטרות ודיבון שהם עבר הירדן שהם עצמן בחינת תרגום אף על פי כן צריך לקרותם שמו"ת. כי שבעים פנים לתורה ומקרא אחד מתחלק לכמה טעמים ועל כן נאמר משנה תורה בעבר הירדן שהוא בחינת שלימות לשון הקדש על ידי תרגום כנ"ל. ועל כן קורין אותה בליל הושענא רבא. כי אז צריכין לזה כנ"ל. וזה שגומרים אז כל תהלים כי אמירת תהלים הוא תיקון למקרה לילה (כמו שכתב רבינו ז"ל) ומקרה בא על ידי בחינת תרדמה בחינת תרגום (כמבוא שם במאמר תפלה לחבקוק) ועל כן בליל הושענא רבא שאז צריכין לתיקון בחינת פה כנ"ל שהוא בחינת ערבה כנ"ל. על כן נעורים כל הלילה ומשברין השינה וקוראין משנה תורה ותהלים כדי לזכות לשלימות לשון הקדש על ידי לשון תרגום כנ"ל).
segments.en:
✦ ✦ ✦

~ 10 ~

And this is the aspect of the four cups of wine. For wine has the numerical value of seventy — as our Sages said. For when one subdues the all-encompassing desire and merits to leave the exile of the seventy nations, which is the above desire — which is the aspect of the Exodus from Mitzrayim — then one merits the revelation of the Torah, which is the aspect of seventy faces of the Torah. And then one can drink wine, which has the numerical value of seventy, and merit through it the secrets of the Torah — the aspect of: "Wine enters, a secret emerges." And therefore wine has the same two forces as the Torah: "he merited — it becomes for him an elixir of life," etc. As our Sages said regarding wine: "he merited — he becomes a head; he did not merit — he becomes poor." For it is all according to the vessel, according to one's capacity to grasp the mochin. And one whose vessel is in a state of completeness through guarding the bris — he can drink wine, since he has already subdued the evil of the seventy nations. And therefore through the wine he can merit the revelation of the Torah, the aspect of seventy faces of the Torah — the aspect of "he merited — he becomes a head": the aspect of head and mochin, meaning he merits new mochin, the aspect of the revelation of the Torah.

But "he did not merit — he becomes poor." And "there is no poor person but one lacking in da'as." For since he did not merit and his vessel is not in a state of completeness, additional foolishness accrues to him — for it becomes for him an elixir of death, chas v'shalom. For the essential rectification of wine is according to the rectification of the bris — as our Sages said: "One who sees a sotah in her disgrace should abstain from wine." That is, when there is a blemish of the bris, one must abstain from wine. For one can drink wine only when one has rectified the bris and merited to leave the exile of Mitzrayim — that is, from the evil desire of the seventy nations, which is the desire for immorality. And then one can drink wine — which has the numerical value of seventy — and merit through it the revelation of the Torah. And therefore on Pesach, at the time of the Exodus from Mitzrayim, it is a mitzvah to drink wine. And this is the aspect of the four cups, corresponding to the four expressions of redemption, corresponding to the four camps of the Sh'chinah — the aspect of the four banners, which are the twelve tribes of Y-a-h, corresponding to the twelve oxen upon which the Kingdom of holiness stands — "three facing north and three facing south," etc. — aligned just like the four banners that traveled in the four directions. And the essential tikkun of the bris is through the twelve tribes of Y-a-h — which is the aspect of Sh'ma and Baruch Shem (as explained in the discourse). And this is the aspect of the four cups of wine — in the aspect of the tikkun of the bris.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 11 ~

And this is the aspect of eating maror. This alludes to what our Rebbe wrote in the above discourse: that the essential desire comes from the turbidity of the blood that comes from the spleen, which is the black bile. And therefore one must shed tears at the time of accepting the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven — in order to emerge from the above thoughts, for one who is habituated in them, chas v'shalom — see there. And this is the aspect of maror — a remembrance of "they embittered their lives" — the aspect of the above desire, which is the aspect of black bile. And therefore we eat the maror now — in order to sweeten and subdue and break the bitterness of the desire. For we dip the maror in charoses, which is the aspect of chas + Rus (as brought in the Kavanos). Chas + Rus — this is the aspect of the Kingdom of holiness, the woman of yiras Hashem. For Rus is the aspect of the woman of yiras Hashem, from whom Dovid descended — who is the aspect of the Kingdom of holiness. And chas has the numerical value of chayyim (life) — as is brought — the aspect of the woman of yiras Hashem about whom it is said: "See life with the woman whom you love." And this is the aspect of the tikkun of the bris — for the Kingdom of holiness, the aspect of the woman of yiras Hashem, is the aspect of the tikkun of the bris. And this is that we dip the maror in charoses — to subdue the aspect of black bile, the aspect of the above desire, through the aspect of the Kingdom of holiness.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 12 ~

And this is the aspect of the seventh day of Pesach — the aspect of the splitting of Yam Suf. For the sea split into twelve parts — as it is written: "Who split Yam Suf into parts" — corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. For the impure thoughts that come upon a person are the aspect of the depths of the sea (m'tzulos yam), as is brought. And the tikkun for the thoughts is Sh'ma and Baruch Shem, which have twelve words corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. And therefore when the Mitzrim pursued them and overtook them camped by the sea — this is the aspect of the above desire, the exile of the seventy nations, the aspect of the exile of Mitzrayim, pursuing a person, especially at the time when one flees from it, when it intensifies all the more, as is known. And then the depths of the sea intensify upon a person — the aspect of impure thoughts. And all this is because they left before the appointed end, for they were not yet worthy of leaving. And therefore it pursues a person and seeks to overpower him — the aspect of the depths of the sea, which are the thoughts.

And the tikkun for the thoughts, which are the aspect of the depths of the sea, is the aspect of the Sea of Sh'lomoh, the Kingdom of Heaven — the aspect of Sh'ma and Baruch Shem (as explained in the discourse). For the Sea of Sh'lomoh stands upon twelve oxen, which are the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. And this is the aspect of the splitting of Yam Suf, which split into twelve parts corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-a-h, upon which the sea of holiness stands — the aspect of the Sea of Sh'lomoh. And then the raging waters — the depths of the sea — were driven out and nullified, and the children of Yisrael came into the sea of holiness on dry land. For the raging waters — the depths of the sea, the aspect of impure thoughts — that seek to overpower the sea of holiness, the sea of wisdom, for their essential hold is in a person's da'as (the sea of wisdom, for all thoughts and reflections are within the da'as and brain) — now they were driven out and nullified, and the sea of holiness remained standing upon the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. And this is the aspect of the splitting of Yam Suf into twelve parts. And the essential splitting of Yam Suf was through the aspect of Yosef, who is the aspect of guarding the bris — as it is written: "The sea saw and fled" — "and he went outside." For the essential aspect of the splitting of the sea is through guarding the bris — the aspect of the Sea of Sh'lomoh standing upon the twelve tribes of Y-a-h.

And through the aspect of Yosef — guarding the bris, the aspect of "he fled outside" — through this: "the sea saw and fled." This is the aspect of: "From before Sarai my mistress I am fleeing" — brought there in the discourse. For the impure thoughts — the depths of the sea, the aspect of the evil kingdom — flee from before the aspect of Yosef, from before the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. And then the sea split — for the sea remained standing upon the twelve tribes of Y-a-h, and then the twelve tribes of Y-a-h could pass through it on dry land, walking and passing through the sea of wisdom without obstruction from the depths of the sea. And therefore at the time they crossed the sea, the sea of wisdom was revealed to them — as our Sages said: "A maidservant saw at the sea," etc. For the evil maidservant — the mother of the Airev Rav, the evil kingdom, the above desire — was subdued. And then even the lowest levels of Yisrael — even the maidservant of Yisrael — were all included in holiness, since the evil maidservant was nullified. And therefore "a maidservant saw" specifically "at the sea," etc.

All this occurred on the sixth day of the S'firah. For even though on the night of Pesach a great illumination was drawn upon them, nevertheless afterward, after the first day, they went back to progressing from level to level through S'firas HaOmer (as explained in the Kavanos). That is, even though on the night of Pesach the light was drawn upon them from Above in the aspect of blessing, even though they had not yet rectified their vessels in completeness — nevertheless, afterward this illumination departed, and they had to receive the light gradually: according to the rectification of their vessels during the days of the S'firah, so they merited to receive the light of da'as — the holy Torah — on the fiftieth day, which is Chag HaShavuos.

✦ ✦ ✦

segments.he: ואחר כך על ידי כל התיקונים האלה שזכו לבחינת מקיפים שהוא שלימו הדעת. על כן אחר כך שמחת תורה. כי אז אנו זוכין להשגת תורה הסתומה בחינת אורייתא דעיקא סתימאה דעתידא לאתגליא לעתיד לבא. כי שמחת תורה הוא בחינת התכלית האחרון (כמובא בספרים) ועל כן מסיימין אז התורה ומתחילין תיכף להורות שזוכין לבחינת אורייתא דעתיקא שהוא כלא ימינא. ואין בה ראש וסוף. רק כולה אחדות פשוט. וזה בחינת ההקפות שמקיפים עם התורה בבחינת כולא ימינא. כי המקיף מקיף דרך ימין כמו שכתוב במשנה. נמצא שבבחינת ההקפות אין שם ראש וסוף וצדדים והם בחינת כולא ימינא כנ"ל ששזה בחינת התורה הסתימה הנ"ל שזוכין אז כנ"ל.כי עיקר השגת אירייתא סתימאה הנ"ל הוא על ידי הכנעת הרע כמו שכתב רבינו ז"ל במאמר מי האיש החפץ חיים (בסימן ל"ג) שעל ידי שמתגבר על יצרו על ידי זה מכניע ומבטל הרע ששוכן על הטוב ועל ידי זה נתגלה התורה המוכסה ונעלמת בין לשונות העמים ואז על ידי זה זוכה כנ"ל לאורייתא דעתיקא סתימאה הנ"ל (עיין שם היטב). וזהו בחינת ניסוך המים המרומז בין נסכי הפרים שהם כנגד שבעים אומות שמתמעטין והולכין כמו שאמרו רז"ל להורות שם בין האומות הנ"ל מלובש שם התורה הנעלמת ביניהם. ועל כן כשמכניעין אותן שיהיו מתמעטין והולכין אז נתגלה התרוה שביניהם שהיתה מכוסה עד עכשיו כי המים הם בבחינת התורה הסתומה הנ"ל כמו שכתוב ושאבתם מים בששון ותרגומו ומקלבון אולפן חדת ועל כן נעשה זה בסוכות שאז הוא הכנעת הרע של כל השבעים אומות על ידי התיקונים שעושין אז כנ"ל. וזה בחינת שמחת בית השואבה. וזה בחינת שמח תורה שמחים מאד שזכו להשיג אורייתא סתימאה על ידי נצחון המלחמה והתיקונים של ימי הסוכות כנ"ל ברוך ה' לעולם אמן ואמן.
segments.en:
~ 13 ~

And this is the aspect of the 49 days of the S'firah, corresponding to the 49 letters in the acceptance of the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven in Sh'ma and Baruch Shem, which correspond to the 49 letters in the names of the twelve tribes of Y-a-h. And through the counting of these days, which are the aspect of vessels — for the days are the aspect of vessels and middos — through this one leaves impurity for purity and rectifies the days and the vessels, in order to merit receiving the light of the Torah on Shavuos in the aspect of blessing through the rectification of the vessels. And therefore on the sixth day of the S'firah, which is the aspect of Yosef — the aspect of guarding the bris — then the sea split into twelve parts corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-a-h, which are the aspect of the tikkun of the bris.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 14 ~

And therefore after the seven days of Pesach, chamaitz is once again permitted to be eaten. And as is brought in the Zohar — a parable of a prince — for after they received matzah, which is the remedy, they can eat chamaitz — see there. For initially they were compelled to eat only matzah, which is the aspect of the light drawn from Above in the aspect of blessing, not through our own agency — the aspect of "Behold, to bless I have taken." And through this they left Mitzrayim, from impurity to purity, and merited the aspect of the tikkun of the bris, and their vessels were rectified through this. And afterward, during the six days of the S'firah, their vessels were also somewhat rectified, and they merited the aspect of the splitting of Yam Suf into twelve parts — all of which is the aspect of the tikkun of the bris. And then their vessels were rectified, and they could depict the light in the aspect of blessing. And then they could eat chamaitz, which is the aspect of depiction — for then Yisrael could depict the light for blessing through the rectification of their vessels. And therefore on Shavuos we offer the two loaves of chamaitz specifically — for then we depict the light for blessing and receive the holy Torah in the aspect of blessing through the rectification of the vessels in the 49 days of the S'firah. And therefore we offer chamaitz specifically then — which is the aspect of depicting the light for blessing through the rectification of the vessels in the 49 days of the S'firah. Blessed is Hashem forever, Amain v'Amain.

✦ ✦ ✦

~ 15 ~

And therefore we eat matzah for seven days — for each day includes ten, and they correspond to the seventy cries corresponding to the exile of the seventy nations from which they merited to leave — which is the aspect of the Exodus from Mitzrayim. And throughout all these seven days one must eat matzah, which is the aspect of the light drawn from Above in the aspect of blessing — in order to subdue the exile of the seventy nations and to merit the aspect of seventy faces of the Torah. (And see well the entire discourse, "When evildoers draw near to me," from beginning to end, and then all these matters are explained properly.)
